TEXT:
[FI] Enjoying the scenery without a care in the world, 
this does feel rather nice~

TEXT: [FI] It does...

beyond the endless blue horizon. We're having a 
short break after lunch.

with at the end.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you sure that's okay with you?

TEXT: [FI] Mhm! It's good to eat those every once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sure, but that was just fast food.

a regular basis, but it's supposed to be a special 
event, y'know?

TEXT: [FI] You don't like fast food, Kyou-chan?

[FI] It's not that, it just doesn't seem like an expensive 
treat... Man, to think I got psyched after getting my 
pay... However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...If you're happy, then I'm fine with it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I haven't had anything that good in a while. 
Kyou-chan, thanks for the meal!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Oh... Let's get something more delicious next time.
[FI] Geez, why is my girlfriend so selfless.

more fashionable. She seems to be conscious of her 
outfits these days.

[FI] Even though she doesn't stand out―― She won't 
embarrass me in public, a girlfriend I'm proud of.

[FI] Well, her appearance changed, but her personality's 
still the same. That’s just how she is.

[FI] The eyes behind Manami's glasses haven't changed 
at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] The weather is really great today. I bet the 
laundry's almost dry now.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah.. Are you the type that does their own laundry 
at home?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nope! I'm just saying, like in genera...

[FI] We've been dating for a year now, our relationship 
hasn't progressed much at all.

[FI] Sometimes I wonder, what does Manami think of 
me?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] *yawn* I'm so full, I'm getting sleepyyy~

[FI] I have so much on my mind and yet, Manami was 
letting out yawns without a care in the world.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You'll become a cow if you sleep right after eating, 
you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=24]Hueh?[/font_size]

TEXT: [FI] I'm joking...

TEXT:

sleepiness!

TEXT: [FI] Ahh, you'll feel more alert when you stretch!

[FI] WHOA?!

usual...?!

grown amazingly well. Thank god!

TEXT: [FI] Hm? What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ugh...

TEXT:

behavior, it'll be abnormal if he isn’t interested, but look, 
I'm absolutely not thinking of anything dirty!!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Oh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ahh...

control there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'd be lying if I said I wasn't the least bit interested, 
but they say with these kinds of things, we should 
take it step by step.

TEXT:
[FI] Mmhm, I understand, since Kyou-chan cares a lot 
about me, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What are you even saying...

[FI] I feel like I just destroyed a hard-earned flag 
somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe, I'm kind of happy about it~

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, but we can’t go on like this.

childhood friends, we'll never really become 
“lovers” in the full sense of the word, would we?

[FI] We have to progress further in our relationship 
during the summer holidays somehow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] *yawn* Looks like I'm getting sleepy as well...

TEXT: [FI] Ah, in that case...

[FI] Upon hearing that, she lightly patted her lap and 
extended her arms.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] H-Here you go...

TEXT: [FI] Eh?

ago too...
[FI] So that's what she meant back then!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:

guess...

wide open.

TEXT:

TEXT: [FI] S-Stop that~

TEXT: [FI] Ahaha, I'm joking, just joking!

TEXT: [FI] A-Are you sure...

TEXT: [FI] C-Can I stay like this for a while?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...-u-chan, Kyou-chan.

TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan, are you awake?

TEXT: [FI] You'll catch a cold at this rate, you know?

TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]Uwaa?![/font_size]

TEXT: [FI] I-I'm sorry! I just dozed off and...

TEXT: [FI] Mhm~ You looked like you enjoyed yourself.

TEXT:
[FI] The sun's setting. I was planning to walk around a 
bit more...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, you had somewhere you wanted to go? Sorry

TEXT:
[FI] No, it's fine. I bet you're bored by now? You've 
been sitting in this position for a long time, haven't 
you?

TEXT: [FI] Eh, not at all.

TEXT:

TEXT:
[FI] Now if only we had some rice crackers and green

TEXT: [FI] No, that's just asking for too much.

limits too, especially with that speech.

TEXT:
[FI] But, it'll get cold after the sunset. It'd be terrible if 
we caught a cold.
